buildMethod: One patch layer on each published v0.3.16 image (pulled by digest on cx53): the two files below copied from an exact git archive of the source commit, mode 0664 as in v0.3.16, then generate_results.py --help under the agent interpreter.
dockerfile:
ARG PARENT
FROM ${PARENT}
COPY --chmod=0664 pod/scripts/generate_results.py /opt/pod/scripts/generate_results.py
COPY --chmod=0664 app/Sources/ConceptStudio/Resources/Training/model-table.json /opt/pod/scripts/model-table.json
RUN /opt/venvs/agent/bin/python -I /opt/pod/scripts/generate_results.py --help > /dev/null
sourceDiffFromParent: Between v0.3.16's source (86561c4) and 461bb37 the only image inputs that changed are these two files.
builder: cx53 (rootless Docker); pushed with the Mac's registry credential against the cx53 daemon
checks: Each parent's local image ID equals its published index digest.
All seven images carry both files with the source hashes above, and the agent interpreter loads the table and resolves the Krea 2 AI Toolkit pairing.
In the AI Toolkit image, the pinned toolkit's ModelConfig gives the VAE float16 from the captured model block alone and bf16 with the train dtype, the fix's cause and effect.
All seven tags resolve anonymously from ghcr.io.
